podcast.body: This album was Dishwalla's major label debut, released in 1995. It was a massive success, selling over half a million copies in the US shortly after its release. Despite this initial success, a second record on the same label three years later failed to garner significant attention. "In 1995, they released a major label debut called Pet Your Friends."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Great Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of the 90s: Part 2
